name: Fonterra Co-operative Group Limited
summary: Fonterra Co-operative Group Limited, together with its subsidiaries, collects, manufactures, and sells milk and milk-derived products. The company offers whole and skim milk powders, cream, yoghurt, butter, dairy fats, proteins, and cheese products. It also engages in the ingredients, consumer goods and food service channel businesses. The company sells its products through retail stores. In addition, it operates Farm Source stores. Further, the company provides its products primarily under the Anchor, Anmum, Anlene, Chesdale, NZMP, Farm Source, De Winkel, Fresh 'n Fruity, Kapiti, Mainland, Mammoth, Perfect Italiano, Primo, and Nutiani brands.
